anyOf.description: IMAP configuration. Set to `false` when there is no IMAP access to configure.

useAuthServer.description: Use external authentication server to retrieve credentials dynamically

x-meta.usage:
Turn this on when passwords must not be stored in EmailEngine, for instance when they are short-lived or held in your own vault. EmailEngine then calls your authentication server for credentials each time it needs to connect, and the `auth` block must be omitted.

The authentication server URL itself is an instance-wide setting, not a per-account one.

anyOf.description: Authentication credentials for the IMAP server

x-meta.usage:
Send this for ordinary password authentication. Omit it when `useAuthServer` is on, because EmailEngine then fetches credentials from your authentication server for every connection and a stored password would be dead configuration.

On an update this replaces the whole credentials object unless `partial` is also set.

disableIMAP4rev2.description: Do not use IMAP4rev2 even if the server supports it

x-meta.usage:
Set this only after a server has actually misbehaved. A handful of IMAP servers advertise IMAP4rev2 support and then answer incorrectly, and this forces EmailEngine back to IMAP4rev1 for that account.

It has no effect on accounts that authenticate with OAuth2.

resyncDelay.description: Delay in seconds between full mailbox resynchronizations

maxIdleTime.description: Restart IDLE after this many milliseconds. Also caps the polling interval for servers without IDLE support.

x-meta.usage:
Leave this unset unless the server, or something between it and EmailEngine, drops idle connections. Some providers close an IDLE session after a few minutes without saying BYE, which shows up as a reconnect every few minutes. Set a value below that limit, for instance 120000 for a connection that drops after about four and a half minutes, and EmailEngine ends and restarts IDLE that often, so the connection never looks idle.

A handful of providers (Yahoo, Rambler, 163.com) already get a built-in value; one set here takes precedence over it. Unlike `disableIMAP4rev2` it also applies to accounts that authenticate with OAuth2. Changing it reconnects the account.

junkMailPath.description: Custom folder path for spam/junk messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Junk" folder. Set to null to use default.

trashMailPath.description: Custom folder path for deleted messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Trash" folder. Set to null to use default.

archiveMailPath.description: Custom folder path for archived messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Archive" folder. Set to null to use default.
